profile: BF16 storage/output, FP32 accumulation; F32 pedantic; no FP16/TF32/fast-math fallback

decisions.operations: GEMM, bias epilogue, packed K/V and tiled BF16 attention
decisions.transfer: Encoder/DiT use actual GEMM shapes; quantized LLM decode GEMV/MMVQ is not substituted. Tensor Core BF16 operations accumulate FP32 and preserve oracle output casts.
decisions.hypothesis: Matching native library version, admitted workspace and BF16 boundaries removes amplified encoder drift without changing tolerance.
decisions.rejected: cuBLAS 12.3 differed from the oracle at BF16 boundaries; merely increasing a score tile or changing algebraic form did not explain all drift.
decisions.qualified: Native cuBLAS/cuBLASLt 13.1.1, 8519680-byte owned handle workspace; Lt bias workspace bounded at 1 MiB. Legacy binaries keep CUDA 12.

decisions.operations: FP32 online attention, relative audio score, softcap
decisions.transfer: Independent CUDA C implementation with four query warps per CTA and two score passes; no Triton or C++ graph copied. GQA/MQA, head dimensions through 512, explicit bounds and scale.
decisions.hypothesis: Linear workspace can preserve the declared score/probability casts without an N-by-N production allocation.
decisions.limitation: Correctness baseline, not a claim of FlashAttention throughput on sm_86. BF16 eager oracle uses separately rounded QK and probabilities and therefore has its own bounded tile path.

decisions.transfer: C equations and native CUDA reductions; explicit Welford FMA order, four-accumulator RMS reduction, normalization cast before direct scale where required. Split-half and adjacent rotations are distinct.
decisions.hypothesis: Reduction and rounding order, including cosine/sine dtype, must match before judging end-to-end error.

decisions.operations: Convolution, asymmetric padding, pooling, reorder, nearest-exact
sources: frozen Transformers audio/vision and Diffusers VAE equations
decisions.transfer: Existing installed cuDNN is preferred over a new convolution implementation. CPU direct reference is independent. Padding and layout kernels are small C/CUDA implementations.
decisions.hypothesis: Deterministic FP32 accumulation and post-cast convolution bias preserve real patch outputs within T00 with bounded workspace.
decisions.dependency_cost: CUDA target needs native cuDNN 9.24.0 and its shared dependencies; CPU reference and legacy LLM links do not acquire that dependency.

decisions.operations: Vision uint8 resize, normalization and patch ordering
decisions.transfer: Independent separable C bicubic with quantized coefficients and uint8 intermediate, followed by strict FP32 normalization. Legacy vision keeps its original direct floating-point resize.
decisions.rejected: Single floating-point 2D bicubic changed uint8 pixels and amplified vision hidden-state drift.

decisions.operations: Image tokenizer NFC and character classes
decisions.transfer: Offline generation of data only, native strict UTF-8/NFC and byte BPE. No inference-time Python or tokenizers dependency. Class boundaries and all Unicode scalars for NFC are tested independently.
decisions.rejected: Host NFC and newer legacy Qwen character classes are not equivalent to the frozen image tokenizer.

decisions.transfer: Selected execution groups reuse the verified mmap loader and resource ownership. Dense resident encoder weights do not benefit from mechanically importing MoE expert-cache scheduling.
decisions.limitation: Unsloth Q4_K_M manifest remains a candidate for T20, not a qualified compute path.

evidence.benchmark: Five synchronized repetitions after warmup; full statistics and instability verdict in verification.json. No speedup claim.
